title: Separated presheaf of lattice images
statement: Let X be a scheme, J its pro-etale topology, R and S sheaves of commutative rings on J, a : R → S a ring-sheaf morphism, and L an S-module sheaf. An integral lattice pair on U consists of a finite locally free R|U-module P and a specified isomorphism S|U ⊗ P ≅ L|U, with the sheafified tensor product. For U let F(U) be the families of subsets s(T) ⊆ L(T), over all T over U, represented by the embedded images of some lattice pair on U. Precomposition with Over.map defines a presheaf F. If the coefficient map is injective on every slice test object, equality of two such families can be checked on any covering sieve, so F is separated. [lem-weil-pbc-lattice-pair-restriction, lem-weil-pbc-lattice-image-locality].

source.place: Proposition 6.8.4(6), pp. 59–60; Descent and an exact presentation of lattice classes

proof.text: Precompose the family with Over.map. Pair restriction proves representability; associativity gives the functor laws. Compare images on the pullback covering sieve and use local membership to prove equality.
